themes.label: Fabric basket hard to reshape after flat packing
quotes: very hard to get the fabric to stay straight without wrinkles
It is very difficult to get into shape after arriving flat
themes.fix: Ship fabric/woven planters pre-formed or rolled with a stiffener insert, not folded flat; add reshaping instructions.

themes.label: No drainage holes
quotes: my only gripe is that it doesn't have any drainage
But it doesn't have a drainage hold.
themes.fix: Clearly label as a cachepot (no drainage) in the listing, or offer a variant with drainage holes and plug.

themes.label: Thin / cheaply made wooden planters
quotes: Looks as though they will rot quicker than more sturdy planters
A bit thinner than I hoped
themes.fix: Specify thicker timber and pre-line with a waterproof liner; state board thickness on the spec sheet.

themes.label: Attached drainage saucer hard to detach
quotes: this is fiddly (hence 4*)to detach for watering
it's very difficult to remove the drainage saucer
themes.fix: Redesign saucer with an easy twist-off or loose-fit tray, and test detachment before shipping.

themes.label: Finish worn or imperfect
quotes: lots of places on drainage saucer where the gold part is worn away
the stain comes out when watering
themes.fix: Add finish QC and a sealed lacquer/colour-fast coating so gold and stain don't wear or leach.
